label: Galleon NTS-4000 Stratum-1 NTP server
description: 1U Stratum-1 NTP/SNTP time server (PTPv2 master clock on licensed variants) synchronised from a 32-channel multi-GNSS active antenna or from MSF/DCF77/WWVB radio broadcasts, sized for very large client counts including 100,000 NTP clients. The standard unit ships with two RJ45 10/100BASE-T LAN ports that carry PoE, expandable to six LAN ports; the RS-232 D-Sub ports, 1PPS BNC and the RS-485 antenna inputs are not network ports.
